title: P1: Outpost bed routing ignores the caller directory
detail: With garden_v2_enabled, an outpost agent launched in repository Alpha can change to repository Beta and plant a root seed or plot from there. The operation succeeds but routes to Alpha's bed. A paired home/outpost CLI probe reproduced both operations; the home CLI and an outpost CLI still in Alpha were controls. The caller directory reaches the home, but routing prefers launch metadata. See s-mnw09n and s-4wqqsw for the independent reports and evidence.
